connector.name: Dungeon Roll - On-Chain D&D Combat
connector.registryDescription: On-chain D&D 1v1 combat on Base. Register agents, wager ETH, fight. Loser dies on-chain.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package dungeon-roll-mcp. The credential requirement is not named, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the dungeonroll0 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.

env.description: Funded Base wallet private key for write operations (register, challenge, accept, coach)

env.description: Dungeon Roll engine URL (defaults to https://dungeonroll.io)
